reason: I got burned on my last work with a builder who ran over budget and dragged on for months, so I will not pay anyone to pick a contractor for me until I know what it costs and who stands behind the money. The price is not even stated, so I cannot tell whether the fee is worth it.
objection: Nobody has said what the platform takes, and I do not know whether the escrow and payment handling protects me if the builder walks off or the job overruns.
would_change_my_mind: A stated fee in dollars or as a percentage, plus a sample contract showing payments released only at agreed milestones and a refund if the builder misses the deadline.
